newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore rubber dealers mark time in quiet trade.
newsitem.headline: Singapore rubber dealers mark time in quiet trade.

text.p: Trading in the Singapore rubber market was quiet in the morning on Wednesday with players sitting on the sidelines waiting for leads in the afternoon session, dealers said.

"The big consumers were not really in. Some people are still talking about the possible rubber deal between Thailand and China. But the situation is basically quiet and we'll be looking for leads in the afternoon," a dealer said.
Singapore rubber traders said there has been constant talk in the market that China will buy about 80,000 tonnes of rubber from Thailand for delivery in the second half of 1997.
